resources.string: Step 1: save an encrypted backup. Wrong codes give no hint, and if you forget your code, the backup is the only way to get your data back (reinstall, then restore it).
Opens a separate, empty space instead of your data.
Replaces the app icon with a working calculator or notes app. Entering your code there opens HRT Log.
Restores the normal icon, removes both codes and deletes everything in the decoy space.
Shake the phone at any time to go back to the disguise.
To open: type your code, then press =.
To open: tap search and search for your code.
Still visible: the real app name in the system’s app list and settings, and in the header of notifications. Your home screen may drop the old shortcut; add the new icon from the app drawer.
The decoy code must be different from your code.
Backup saved. Now choose the look and your code.
The backup could not be saved. Try again or pick another location.
To turn it off: open the app with your code, then Settings → Disguise mode → Turn off disguise.
From now on, the app appears as “%1$s” on your home screen and in the app drawer.
Forgot the code? Uninstall the app, install it again and restore the backup you just saved.
Leaving the app locks it at once and brings back the disguise. Choosing a file for import or export is the only exception.
